primary: At beta index 8 the frozen 250-byte RSMI representation retains at least half of within-temperature variance of A-species X-star intensity, and separately beats the strongest equal-size cold-selected conventional encoder for it.
utility: R2_centered = 1 - Var(error)/Var(Y) within a temperature. Raw R2 separately retains mean error; no model refitting or new microscopic observations at transfer. Paired whole-parent jackknife normal/t intervals conditional on frozen probes. Beta=0 is a control for RSMI specificity, not an expectation of zero ability to encode occupancies.
targets: mean of S_A(pi,0,0) over three axes
mean of S_A(2pi/L,0,0) over three axes
readout: Same fixed ridge on three symbol frequencies, their six quadratic moments, all 48 directed nearest-tile pair frequencies and six reduced first-wave power bilinears. The X target alone can be estimated from counts, so this is not a lower limit on bytes needed for that single quantity.
format: Nonoverlapping stride-2 tiles at origin 0. Flatten 10^3 labels z,y,x and pack four labels in each byte, least significant label first. 250 bytes per parent, excluding amortized table/probe and row identifiers. Lossy: never replace microscopic archives. 8x smaller than packing 8000 microscopic species into two bits each.
